seeds.publicSurface: A four-address comparison of source, representation, previous trace and changed state.
seeds.proofUnit: A digest-bound synthetic frame and deterministic comparison test.
seeds.privateCoreExcluded: Full LUCINET orchestration and private source archives.
seeds.reopenTrigger: A new representation with both previous and current digests.

seeds.publicSurface: One source-bound note with two declared reading orders.
seeds.proofUnit: Both readings resolve to the same immutable source digest.
seeds.reopenTrigger: A reader identifies a material meaning change caused by order.

seeds.publicSurface: A card that preserves one unresolved but decision-relevant gap.
seeds.proofUnit: The card names source, current state and discriminator without inventing an answer.
seeds.privateCoreExcluded: Any identity behind the initial K.
seeds.reopenTrigger: A source explicitly binds K to a role or referent.

seeds.publicSurface: A small state snapshot with event time, recorded time, digest and open branch.
seeds.proofUnit: Round-trip validation of the public JSON snapshot.
seeds.privateCoreExcluded: The private world model and source media.
seeds.reopenTrigger: A later snapshot changes a declared public field.

seeds.publicSurface: One compact idea intended to create a reusable question rather than disclose a whole system.
seeds.proofUnit: Public artifact, license, test and claim ceiling.
seeds.privateCoreExcluded: Unreleased mechanisms, active-main code, secrets and private identities.
seeds.reopenTrigger: An independent continuation cites the released artifact and adds a differentiating result.
